findings.description: Priority 1 WCAG contrast recommendation lacks a specific selector, page URL or count – generic design‑token fix.
Priority 2 heading hierarchy recommendation does not reference any particular heading element or page – generic instruction.
Priority 3 main landmark recommendation is generic; no specific page, selector or instance count provided.
Priority 4 semantic structure recommendation references only generic container types without a concrete selector or page context.
Priority 6 structured‑data property gaps recommendation lists missing properties but does not point to specific entities, pages or selectors.
Priority 7 schema.org coverage recommendation is generic; no specific entity or selector cited.
Priority 8 llms.txt recommendation prescribes publishing a file at the root but does not reference any audit‑derived data point beyond the missing file itself.
Priority 9 intended audience recommendation is generic; no specific page, selector or count provided.
